fields.title: Use name prefix
fields.description: The scores (i.e. accuracy, error rate, number of correct and wrong classification) are exported as flow variables with a hard coded name. This option allows you to define a prefix for these variable identifiers so that name conflicts are resolved.

fields.title: Prefix for flow variables
fields.description: The prefix to use for flow variable names.

fields.title: Missing values
fields.description: Choose how to treat missing values in either the reference or prediction column. Default is to ignore them (treat them as if the row did not exist). Alternatively, you can expect the table to not contain missing values in these two columns. If they do, the node will fail during execution.
